{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
* 4 boneless skinless [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]] breasts
* ½ cup extra-virgin [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
* 3 tbsp [[Cookbook:Smoky Chipotle Hot Sauce|Smoky Chipotle Hot Sauce]]
* ¼ cup freshly squeezed [[Cookbook:Lime|lime]] juice
* 2 tbsp [[Cookbook:Honey|honey]]
* ½ cup [[Cookbook:Chipotle BBQ Rub|Chipotle BBQ Rub]]

== Procedure ==
#Combine all ingredients except for BBQ Rub in a gallon zip-top plastic freezer bag. Add chicken breasts and refrigerate for 45 minutes.
#Remove chicken from bag. Season each breast with BBQ Rub.
#Place on a preheated charcoal [[Cookbook:Grill|grill]] and cook, turning often, until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
#Remove and let rest for 5 minutes.
#Serve.
